item.title: Batman Beyond Fates: What Happened to Everybody?
item.description:
"Batman Beyond" jumped 40 years into the future, leaving us with tons of questions about the fates of our favorite heroes and villains. But we've got the scoop: the Justice League, Riddler, Nightwing...and beyond.
🌐 Follow us on social media! @dcauwatchtower Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, etc.
🟠 Support us on Patreon! https://patreon.com/dcauwatchtower Early video access, exclusive hangouts, bonus content, and much more!
👚 Nab some WDb merch! https://watchtowerdatabase.com/shop
💬 Hang out with us on Discord! https://discord.com/invite/RWZ7TaxAar
🎙️ "Jump on the Bat-Wagon" - our DCAU podcast where my co-host has never seen it! https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/batwagon
💥 "Legacies of the DCAU" - our webcomic! http://www.legaciesdcau.com
🎵 "Music of the Watchtower Database" soundtrack links! https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/watchtowerdatabase/watchtower-database-storyline-original-short-film-soundtrack
